decision.observation: 9:20 pm; the C press reeled the line back so the bobber is airborne near the rod tip again. The pond sits directly south of the farmer.
decision.hypothesis: Recasting will land the bobber in the pond; today's catches (Joja Cola ×2) came shortly after a cast when a dip cue was pressed with C.
decision.memory: Fishing loop: face water, hold C to cast, press C at the bobber dip; if the bar minigame opens, hold/release LMB to keep the green bar on the fish. Catches: Sunfish (day 5), Joja Cola x2 (day 6).
